evals.prompt: Inspect the before and after OMP session JSONL files from our benchmark run using audit_context.py compare, and report the observed changes in static non_message_tokens, tool_schema_tokens, and prompt_tokens. Do not claim disk deduplication or symlink changes as token reductions.
evals.expected_output: The response must run audit_context.py compare on the before and after files, present exact delta numbers for prompt_tokens and static tokens, distinguish static prefix from history growth, and explicitly state that disk/symlink changes do not reduce prompt tokens by themselves.

evals.prompt: We want to optimize our agent's context window. We do not have any before-and-after session logs or /dump captures yet. How many prompt tokens will we save if we disable unused MCP tools?
evals.expected_output: The response must refuse to invent an unsubstantiated token savings number without a baseline capture. It must guide the user to measure a baseline capture first using audit_context.py inspect or /dump, explain how tool schema tokens contribute to the static prefix, and require an empirical remeasurement.

evals.prompt: Analyze a sensitive /tmp/omp-llm-request-dump.json file that may contain internal API keys and customer records. Provide component size breakdown and advise on reducing context pressure without leaking confidential data or breaking active debugging.
evals.expected_output: The response must inspect the dump safely using audit_context.py without printing user prompts or sensitive tool payloads, report character and UTF-8 byte sizes with the largest components, prioritize masking resolved steps while strictly protecting active errors and test outputs, and explain that character heuristics are not exact model tokens.
